Governance.metaDescription: Board of directors, oversight, AI, and community liaison committees, and honorary members of the Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) A.C.
Governance.heroDescription: The people who lead and coordinate the ecosystem, with clear responsibilities and accountability.
Governance.boardDescription: The cluster's board: government, academia, and industry working together.
Governance.boardYamilDescription: Legal representative of the cluster. Responsible for institutional vision and strategic alliances.
Governance.boardAlvaroDescription: Coordinates the day-to-day operation of the ecosystem and the articulation between nodes, committees, and partners.
Governance.coordinatorsDescription: Leaders of each level in the ecosystem.
Governance.coordinatorsRodrigoDescription: Manages access to capital, public calls, and funding instruments.
Governance.coordinatorsDanielDescription: Drives the development and validation of technological solutions with industry.
Governance.coordinatorsOmarDescription: Runs the events, networks, and programs that keep the entrepreneurial community alive.
Governance.coordinatorsLeninDescription: Administers the spaces and laboratories of the CERHAN II Hub.
Governance.coordinatorsMargaritaDescription: Leads the training and placement of the ecosystem's talent.
Governance.coordinatorsJuanAlbertoDescription: Coordinates the working committees and the participation of cluster volunteers.
Governance.honoraryDescription: People who have made outstanding contributions to the ecosystem and advise the cluster as honorary members.
Governance.transparencyText: The cluster's operational authority rests with the board and node coordinators, while legal representation belongs exclusively to the president. Every institutional decision is recorded in meeting minutes and reported to the members of the association.
Governance.boardRodrigoDescription: Treasurer of the cluster. Funding and investment liaison.
Governance.vigilanciaDescription: The cluster's supervision and transparency body.
Governance.vigilanciaOliverRole: Director of audit and responsible use of resources
Governance.aiDescription: Honorary committee for education, outreach, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
Governance.aiAzulRole: Director of AI education and outreach
Governance.aiBrendaRole: Director of AI ethics and responsible use
Governance.organsDescription: Honorary and oversight bodies that sit alongside the board, each with a public mandate.
Governance.boardWhat: The board is the governing body of CSI A.C. The president is the legal representative; the secretary, treasurer, and cluster manager serve with him for 2026–2028.
Governance.boardPurpose: It directs the association, records decisions in minutes, and reports to members. Operational authority sits here; honorary committees do not replace it.
Governance.boardMetaDescription: Governing body of CSI A.C.: president, secretary, treasurer, and cluster manager.
Governance.vigilanciaWhat: The oversight committee is the cluster's supervision body, independent of the board.
Governance.vigilanciaPurpose: It watches over transparency, audit and responsible use of resources, and tax compliance. The board remains accountable to members through this body.
Governance.vigilanciaMetaDescription: Supervision and transparency body of the Startup and Innovation Cluster.
Governance.aiWhat: The AI committee is an honorary body of the cluster, already in place, for education, outreach, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
Governance.aiPurpose: It trains and communicates about AI in the ecosystem, and looks after ethical, responsible use inside the cluster.
Governance.aiMetaDescription: Honorary committee for AI education, outreach, and ethics at CSI.
Governance.communityWhat: The community and liaison committee is an honorary body of the cluster, already in place, to connect talent, young people, universities, and companies.
Governance.communityPurpose: It strengthens the ecosystem community and opens paths to employability, challenges, and collaboration between those who start companies and those who hire.
Governance.communityMetaDescription: Honorary committee for liaison, talent, and community at the Startup and Innovation Cluster.
Governance.honoraryWhat: Honorary members are people who have made outstanding contributions to the ecosystem and advise the cluster.
Governance.honoraryPurpose: They contribute judgment and network. They have no operational authority and no legal representation.
Governance.honoraryMetaDescription: Honorary advisors of the Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) A.C.
